scope: Read-only extraction from two existing same-seed Mac rule-world measurement records. No new simulation, restoration, timing run, or model request.
source_path_basis: Paths are relative to the source project root; hashes cover original file bytes.

field_definitions.wall_seconds: Elapsed time from time.perf_counter() in the archived instrumentation.
field_definitions.cpu_seconds: Process CPU time from time.process_time() in the archived instrumentation.
field_definitions.initialization: Measured persistent_run.create_run call, including initial archive construction.
field_definitions.phase_totals: Sums of adjacent phase-boundary intervals over all steps. These are instrumented stage intervals, not function-level exclusive profiles.
field_definitions.BOUNDARY: Interval from measured world.step entry to the BOUNDARY checkpoint; includes TickTransaction construction and scenario boundary work.
field_definitions.COMMIT: Interval after FEEDBACK checkpoint through scenario validation, participant capture and prepared snapshot construction, ending at the COMMIT checkpoint; durable publication follows separately.
field_definitions.durable_publish_tail: Interval from the COMMIT checkpoint until world.step returns, including CommitStore.commit and index update.
field_definitions.per_tick: Actual chronological per-step wall/CPU measurements; includes all phase intervals plus small wrapper/check overhead measured before recording the timing.
field_definitions.nested_times_overlapping_observe: Timed social_update and behavior_update calls nested within OBSERVE. Do not add these to phase_totals or total.
field_definitions.terminal_checkpoint: One measured persistent_run.save call after the step loop. Includes CommitStore.load (state recovery from committed deltas), validation/hashing, serialization/compression and durable output; not a pure disk-write measurement. Absolute output path omitted.
field_definitions.total: Full measure() elapsed time from before create_run through return of persistent_run.advance, including terminal checkpoint and control/record overhead. It is not the separate controller-envelope clock.
field_definitions.cprofile_enabled: False for both raw records: phase timers were used, with no cProfile function-level output from these two runs.
field_definitions.derived.per_tick_sum: Arithmetic sum of the original per_tick measurements; not a new timing measurement.
field_definitions.derived.phase_totals_sum: Arithmetic sum of the non-nested phase intervals.
field_definitions.derived.execute_commit_publish_checkpoin: Sum of measured EXECUTE, COMMIT, durable_publish_tail and terminal checkpoint wall time divided by measured total. This groups intervals containing execution and audit/persistence work; it is not an exclusive estimate of validation time.
field_definitions.source_hash: Implementation identity recorded during each run; source-file hashes for the cited implementation paths were independently compared to the current owning files.
field_definitions.code_commit_recorded: Null in the archived profiles. Their recorded source-file hashes, rather than an inferred Git commit, bind the code used.
